answer: An attendance token is burned the moment it is redeemed for a reward, and the pulse of the design is that the burn is recorded on a public ledger anyone can audit. The vault of the scheme is that a burned token can never be redeemed again, so copying the token gives the copier nothing. A Sybil cannot duplicate one attendance into many rewards because the first redemption destroys the token, and the voyage of the burn is visible to every verifier before they pay out.
